title: We decided to stop optimizing our feed for engagement time.
body:
Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling as long as possible. They want you stuck in the app because that looks good on a metric sheet. But we realized that if you are spending two hours reading the news, we probably failed you.

We built Headlinne with a different goal in mind. We want to get you the information you actually care about as quickly as possible so you can get on with your day. That meant changing how our AI ranks stories. Instead of looking for what triggers a reaction, it looks for what matches your specific interests and depth of knowledge.

This engineering choice makes our feed look different. It is often shorter. It is less chaotic. It is designed to be finished. We believe that respecting your time is the most important feature we can offer.

Building an algorithm that prioritizes utility over addiction is harder than it sounds. It requires us to constantly refine how we measure success. But we think it is the only way to build a product that people actually trust.
cta: You can see how we are doing things differently at HEADLINNE.com.
